                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">You are welcome here</h2>
                        
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">For every kind of learner, there&#8217;s a Royal BC Museum moment waiting.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">There are so many ways to experience the stories that make up BC. You could be a first-time visitor or a lifelong local, a teacher or parent with curious youngsters in tow.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">For almost any audience and occasion, we&#8217;ve got a dose of discovery and delight just for you.</p>

                    <div class="accordion-body" data-accordion="foryou-2">
                      <div class="accordion-body-content" hidden id="accordion-foryou-2">
                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">For Visitors to Victoria</h2>
                        
<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">As the only museum dedicated to both the natural and human history of BC, we’re here to ignite your appreciation of our wonderful west coast and the people who live here.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Nestled in the heart of Victoria’s downtown, our walkable grounds boast <a href="https://rbcm.ca/exhibitions/" data-type="page" data-id="352">outdoor exhibits</a> and local-favourite <a href="https://rbcm.ca/food-and-drink/" data-type="page" data-id="1966">food trucks</a>. We’re easily accessible on foot from downtown or by public transit, steps away from must-sees like the BC Legislature, Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park. And in the rare case of rain, our three sprawling floors and IMAX<sup class="trademark">®</sup>&nbsp;theatre are a value-packed way for you (and your family) to fill the whole day.&nbsp;</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">

</div>
</div>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why we&#8217;re worth a visit</h3>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="682" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-1024x682.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-1531" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-1024x682.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2.webp 1571w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Seasonal world-class exhibitions</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our interactive galleries will inspire curious minds of all ages. Even if you’ve visited here before, there’s always something new to spark wonder and learning.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2279" height="1520" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618.webp" alt="Interior of Jonathan Hunt House being admired by two museum visitors. The installation has two large carved wooden poles flanking a large rectangular painted panel. The left pole is of a raven figure and the right pole is of an eagle. Both have outstretched wings and are carved in Northwest Coast formline style and painted black, red, and green. The panel in the middle has a sun design with a human figure, and a circular hole in the torso. A wooden platform and bench sit in front. The room’s walls are panelled wood, and there is an A-frame pointed roof. A painted bench against the left wall is halfway in frame." class="wp-image-1429" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618.webp 2279w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-2048x1366.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2279px) 100vw, 2279px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Vibrant Indigenous cultures</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">See monumental belongings that connect past and present, hear living languages that continue to thrive, and touch and smell cedar carvings that carry deep cultural meaning.</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">

</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Natural history brought to life</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our immersive galleries span from ice age habitats (meet our unofficial mascot, Woolly the mammoth) to present-day forests full of caribou and grizzly bears.&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">

</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Fascinating tales of BC</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Step inside a life-size replica sailing ship and a 19th-century movie theatre. You&#8217;ll get firsthand stories of the diverse communities who have called this place home and made it a unique part of Canada.</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">

<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Beloved outdoor attractions</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Visit the iconic carved poles and Mungo Martin House (Wawadiťła) in Thunderbird Park, explore our native plant garden, and see St. Ann’s Schoolhouse: the oldest standing building in Victoria.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Authentic local experiences</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our bustling events calendar, independent food trucks, and shop full of distinctly BC gifts and art make us a favourite among Victoria residents. We’re proud to be a trusted destination for learning and connection in our beautiful city.</p>
</div>
</div>

                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">For Local Residents &amp; Businesses</h2>
                        
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Reunite with old favourites and dive headfirst into fresh cultural perspectives.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">If you haven’t paid&nbsp;us a visit in the past few years, you might be surprised at what&#8217;s happening here.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our near-daily events and seasonal world-class exhibitions mean there’s always something fresh to see during your next visit. We have events tailored for both families and adults, online and in-person. Whether you’re a newcomer to Victoria or a lifelong resident, you’ll make new memories that connect you to living histories.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The stories of BC run deep, and the museum is here to bring them to the surface. We want you to see yourself and your community reflected in this work. That’s why we’re always enhancing our offerings to make them as diverse as the people who live here.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Let us (re)-introduce ourselves, and we’ll see you soon.&nbsp;</p>

                    <div class="accordion-body" data-accordion="foryou-4">
                      <div class="accordion-body-content" hidden id="accordion-foryou-4">
                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">For Indigenous Communities</h2>
                        
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">There are many opportunities for Indigenous peoples and their communities to engage with the Royal BC Museum.</p>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Across the museum, we are committed to reconciliation, and supporting Indigenous communities in reclaiming, researching and caring for cultural belongings on their own terms.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our <a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/indigenous-collections-and-repatriation/" data-type="page" data-id="1988">Indigenous Collections and Repatriation (ICAR) department</a> works with First Nations, Métis and Inuit communities across BC to care for and return cultural belongings. The department also supports community access to the museum’s collections and helps ensure that Indigenous perspectives shape how these materials are preserved and shared.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-1024x683.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-3514" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-2048x1365.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">Former Repatriation Specialist Michelle Washington in the collections. Print: Art Thompson,&nbsp;<em>Sea Urchin</em>, ICAR 14890 A,B</figcaption></figure>
</div>
</div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Visit the museum</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Indigenous peoples receive free admission</strong>: Simply inform staff at the admission desk when you arrive. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our team is in the process of revisiting the ways Indigenous materials are presented at the museum. These exhibitions have been recently updated in collaboration with community: </p>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Our Living Languages</h4>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Developed in partnership with the First Peoples’ Cultural Council, this exhibition shares the history of disrupted languages in BC, the complexity of these languages, and the people working tirelessly to document and revitalize them.</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://rbcm.ca/exhibition/our-living-languages/">Learn about the exhibition</a></div>



<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://app.seekbeak.com/v/Xw1bQ3Jyq5k">Virtual 360° tour</a></div>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/2026MG0226256_web-1024x683.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-8460" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/2026MG0226256_web-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/2026MG0226256_web-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/2026MG0226256_web-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/2026MG0226256_web-1536x1025.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/2026MG0226256_web-2048x1366.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>

<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Jonathan Hunt House</h4>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This ceremonial house and museum installation allows visitors to enter a recreation of the house of Chief Kwakwabalasami, the late Jonathan Hunt, a Kwakwaka’wakw chief who was born and lived his life in the community of Tsaxis, near Fort Rupert, BC.</p>

                    <div class="accordion-body" data-accordion="foryou-5">
                      <div class="accordion-body-content" hidden id="accordion-foryou-5">
                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">For Students</h2>
                        
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Learning adventures for everything BC</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">We have many resources for all grade levels about BC&#8217;s natural and cultural history that you can use and enjoy. Learn with us in-person or online, and discover the many stories that make up this amazing province.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="682" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-1024x682.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-3948" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-1024x682.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web.webp 2000w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Some of the things you can do here:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Explore animal habitats:</strong> Encounter caribou and grizzlies in our forests, and learn about ancient dinosaurs and mammoths who lived here</li>



<li><strong>Learn about living Indigenous cultures</strong>: Listen to unique languages and explore a ceremonial Kwakwaka’wakw house</li>



<li><strong>Step back in time</strong>: See what life in BC was like over 100 years ago with old-fashioned homes, shops and a photography studio </li>



<li><strong>See world-class exhibits</strong>: We have new special interactive galleries every season</li>



<li><strong>Go to the movies</strong>: Watch epic IMAX<sup class="trademark">®</sup> documentaries on BC&#8217;s biggest screen&nbsp;</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">It doesn’t matter if you’re here for school work or your own interests. As long as you’re just a little bit curious, we’ll have something that will surprise you.&nbsp;When you use the museum in your studies, you can trust what you find here. Everything we say and do is informed by experts in their field who make sure what we share is factual and includes many perspectives.</p>

                    <div class="accordion-body" data-accordion="foryou-6">
                      <div class="accordion-body-content" hidden id="accordion-foryou-6">
                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">For Educators</h2>
                        
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">A world of enriching experiences&nbsp;</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The Royal BC Museum gives schools and educators the resources to bring K-12 classrooms to life. Our museum educators open doors to BC’s natural and cultural legacy, inspiring curiosity and delight while embracing Indigenous learning principles.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">No matter where in BC you teach, we offer a variety of onsite and online offerings and resources designed to captivate and inform students about the place we call home.&nbsp;</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">

</div>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why learn with RBCM?</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From dinosaurs to the living languages of Indigenous peoples to changing ecosystems, our on-site and online offerings explore a wide range of topics about BC, and subjects beyond our borders with a BC lens. Our exhibitions, resources and events are informed by experts, many working right here at the museum and in partnership with institutions around the world.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Serving educators and creating meaningful learning experiences is core to our mandate. Visiting the museum is a hallmark memory for generations of BC students and teachers, and our offerings continue to evolve so that they’re just as memorable for today’s learners.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Offerings for K-12 teachers</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our wide range of programs are designed by museum educators to enrich your curriculum and foster active engagement and critical thinking. Through our inquiry-based, age-appropriate learning programs, we bring the museum and learning to life.</p>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Adult education</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Experience the museum and archives like never before with offerings tailored for adult learners. You’ll learn from experts, re-connect with the museum and explore from a new perspective. Culture, history and community are at the heart of our educational mission.</p>

                    <div class="accordion-body" data-accordion="foryou-7">
                      <div class="accordion-body-content" hidden id="accordion-foryou-7">
                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">For Natural History Nerds</h2>
                        
<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The magnificent plants and animals of British Columbia come to life at the museum.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Plus, did you know our Natural History collection has over 370,000 fascinating specimens? Together, they tell the story of life from millions of years ago to today’s vital ecosystems.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Whether you’re a researcher looking to connect with experts, or simply curious about local flora and fauna, we have endless wonders for you to discover.</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/">More about the Natural History department</a></div>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1365" height="1820" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/53413262728_da4e0f825c_k-edited.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-3352" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/53413262728_da4e0f825c_k-edited.webp 1365w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/53413262728_da4e0f825c_k-edited-225x300.webp 225w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/53413262728_da4e0f825c_k-edited-768x1024.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/53413262728_da4e0f825c_k-edited-1152x1536.webp 1152w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1365px) 100vw, 1365px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">See BC&#8217;s natural history at the museum</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">In our interactive displays, step into in BC&#8217;s diverse landscapes. Encounter modern-day coastal forests, Ice Age landscapes where mammoths rule, and underwater sea cliffs.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Keen minds can engage with our exhibitions and learning programs that bring you up close to life-size replicas, real specimens, and live exhibits all backed by expert knowledge.</p>

<div style="height:4.5rem" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer spacer-medium"></div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Discover our collection</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our vast Natural History collection of specimens and artifacts is organized into several key areas:&nbsp;</p>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/botany-2/" data-type="page" data-id="493">Botany</a></strong>, including vascular plants, mosses, and lichens. It’s one of the biggest reference collections of BC plants in the world.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/entomology/">Entomology</a></strong>, showcasing the diversity of insects and other terrestrial arthropods.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/herpetology/">Herpetology</a></strong>, where we document the diversity of amphibians and reptiles.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/ichthyology/">Ichthyology</a></strong>, where we dive into BC’s waters to understand tens of thousands of fish species.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/invertebrate-zoology/">Invertebrates</a></strong>, including corals, jellyfish, and mollusks.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/mammalogy/">Mammalogy</a></strong>, with hundreds of amazing species of all sizes represented.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/ornithology/">Ornithology</a></strong>, where we take flight with thousands of bird species from across the province.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/palaeontology/">Palaeontology</a></strong>, with over 60,000 fossils spanning 500 million years and capturing ancient life like nowhere else. And&nbsp;yes, that includes dinosaurs!</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="461" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-1024x461.webp" alt="A museum worker examining a wood log specimen on a shelf. She is wearing glasses, a white lab coat and disposable gloves. She holds up a plastic tape against the wood, which is partially covered in bubble wrap. Inside the wide, short shelf is a bright lamp, a large dark tube, other specimens and a box with papers inside." class="wp-image-1551" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-1024x461.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-300x135.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-768x346.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-1536x691.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-2048x922.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-1024x683.webp" alt="A museum worker examines a specimen in the jar. He is wearing glasses and a white face mask, stands in a laboratory." class="wp-image-1658" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-2048x1366.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The collection is a vital resource for scientists across Canada and around the world, as we document and study BC’s stunning biodiversity.&nbsp;</p>

                    <div class="accordion-body" data-accordion="foryou-8">
                      <div class="accordion-body-content" hidden id="accordion-foryou-8">
                        <h2 class="visually-hidden">For Human History Lovers</h2>
                        
<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">We tell stories of culture, community and society in British Columbia from ancient history to present day.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Ranging across centuries and every corner of the province, the Human Histories department works to reveal the diversity of life in BC.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Although we have many countless artifacts from years past, the work doesn’t stop there. You’ll also find engaging exhibitions and events with unique perspectives on modern life and community.</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/">More about the Human Histories department</a></div>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1258" height="1675" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-3382" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1.webp 1258w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-225x300.webp 225w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-769x1024.webp 769w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-768x1023.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-1154x1536.webp 1154w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1258px) 100vw, 1258px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">On view at the museum</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Step inside immersive galleries that transport you to different eras. The recently updated <em>Old Town, New Approach </em>and the sailing ship <em>HMS Discovery</em> bring you up close with life in BC in from the 18th to early 20<sup>th</sup> century.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Explore Indigenous peoples&#8217; enduring cultures and traditions. Hear the words of the 30+ First Nations languages in <em>Our Living Languages</em>. Step inside the evocative, recreated ceremonial house and exhibit of Chief Kwakwabalasami (Jonathan Hunt).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Plus, develop a deeper understanding and more memorable experience by joining tours and events led by knowledgeable educators. These fun and informative sessions add details and texture to make every visit unforgettable.</p>

<div style="height:2.25rem" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer spacer-small"></div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Discover our collection</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our extensive Human Histories collection is structured into several areas:</p>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/bc-archaeology/" data-type="page" data-id="4854">BC Archaeology collection</a></strong> has over 215,000 items that capture 10,000 years of history. Together these objects, cultural belongings, specimens and artifacts paint a unique picture of how people have lived on this land, particularly Indigenous communities.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The RBCM is also the BC Provincial Archaeology Repository. See our <a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/bc-archaeology/#repository-resources">repository resources for Archaeologists</a>.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/indigenous-collections-and-repatriation/" data-type="page" data-id="1988">Indigenous collection</a></strong> has over 14,000 cultural belongings from the 19th century to now, from monumental poles to beaded jewelry. This collection is frequently activated through our <a href="https://rbcm.ca/indigenous-collections-and-repatriation/" data-type="page" data-id="1988">Indigenous Collections and Repatriation (ICAR) department</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/indigenous-audio-visual/" data-type="page" data-id="5022">Indigenous Audiovisual collection</a></strong> has over 65,000 images, films and sound recordings that capture Indigenous ways of life in BC.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/modern-history/" data-type="page" data-id="4314">History collection</a></strong> has over 165,000 objects significant to BC and its more recent stories. They document ethnic history, government, evolving industries, community groups and daily life. Textiles are a particular focus with over 32,000 items.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Taken as a whole, these items speak to the diversity, myriad ways of life, and evolving societies of this province. </p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">

                    <h2>You are welcome here</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">For every kind of learner, there&#8217;s a Royal BC Museum moment waiting.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">There are so many ways to experience the stories that make up BC. You could be a first-time visitor or a lifelong local, a teacher or parent with curious youngsters in tow.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">For almost any audience and occasion, we&#8217;ve got a dose of discovery and delight just for you.</p>

                                  <div class="tab-content" id="panel-2-foryou"
                      hidden role="tabpanel" tabindex="-1"
                      aria-labelledby="tab-2-foryou">
                    <h2>For Visitors to Victoria</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">As the only museum dedicated to both the natural and human history of BC, we’re here to ignite your appreciation of our wonderful west coast and the people who live here.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Nestled in the heart of Victoria’s downtown, our walkable grounds boast <a href="https://rbcm.ca/exhibitions/" data-type="page" data-id="352">outdoor exhibits</a> and local-favourite <a href="https://rbcm.ca/food-and-drink/" data-type="page" data-id="1966">food trucks</a>. We’re easily accessible on foot from downtown or by public transit, steps away from must-sees like the BC Legislature, Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park. And in the rare case of rain, our three sprawling floors and IMAX<sup class="trademark">®</sup>&nbsp;theatre are a value-packed way for you (and your family) to fill the whole day.&nbsp;</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why we&#8217;re worth a visit</h3>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="682" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-1024x682.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-1531" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-1024x682.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/bc_dino_2.webp 1571w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Seasonal world-class exhibitions</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our interactive galleries will inspire curious minds of all ages. Even if you’ve visited here before, there’s always something new to spark wonder and learning.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2279" height="1520" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618.webp" alt="Interior of Jonathan Hunt House being admired by two museum visitors. The installation has two large carved wooden poles flanking a large rectangular painted panel. The left pole is of a raven figure and the right pole is of an eagle. Both have outstretched wings and are carved in Northwest Coast formline style and painted black, red, and green. The panel in the middle has a sun design with a human figure, and a circular hole in the torso. A wooden platform and bench sit in front. The room’s walls are panelled wood, and there is an A-frame pointed roof. A painted bench against the left wall is halfway in frame." class="wp-image-1429" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618.webp 2279w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG0606618-2048x1366.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2279px) 100vw, 2279px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Vibrant Indigenous cultures</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">See monumental belongings that connect past and present, hear living languages that continue to thrive, and touch and smell cedar carvings that carry deep cultural meaning.</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2048" height="1365" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/54139831891_6ca65555a2_k.webp" alt="Two children and an adult visitor admiring the Natural History gallery installation. A realistic-looking grizzly bear walks through a canopied forest, approaching a creek filled with smooth pebbles. There is moss covering the forest floor and trees. In the background are wall-height informative displays about trees." class="wp-image-999" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/54139831891_6ca65555a2_k.webp 2048w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/54139831891_6ca65555a2_k-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/54139831891_6ca65555a2_k-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/54139831891_6ca65555a2_k-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/54139831891_6ca65555a2_k-1536x1024.webp 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2048px) 100vw, 2048px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Natural history brought to life</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our immersive galleries span from ice age habitats (meet our unofficial mascot, Woolly the mammoth) to present-day forests full of caribou and grizzly bears.&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2181" height="1454" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG1116117.webp" alt="A visitor inside of the HMS Discovery exhibition, a full-scale replica of a wooden boat from the late 1700s. They are looking at the boat’s interior, where there is a desk, chair and several side tables. On display are a globe, several navigation instruments, quill and inkwell, and books spread about. In the background are shelves installed into the walls and a set of panelled windows." class="wp-image-1434" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG1116117.webp 2181w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG1116117-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG1116117-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG1116117-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG1116117-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2024MG1116117-2048x1365.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2181px) 100vw, 2181px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Fascinating tales of BC</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Step inside a life-size replica sailing ship and a 19th-century movie theatre. You&#8217;ll get firsthand stories of the diverse communities who have called this place home and made it a unique part of Canada.</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2400" height="1600" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2022MG0927-1-1.webp" alt="Wide shot of Mungo Martin House, Wawadiťła, at dusk. The house has a white painted exterior with a Great Killer Whale Northwest Coast formline design in black, green and red. A heraldic carved wooden pole stands in front with yellow, black, red, green and white paintings of animal figures including an eagle at the top. In the background are several other wooden poles, tall trees, and the Royal BC Museum building." class="wp-image-1718" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2022MG0927-1-1.webp 2400w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2022MG0927-1-1-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2022MG0927-1-1-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2022MG0927-1-1-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2022MG0927-1-1-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2022MG0927-1-1-2048x1365.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2400px) 100vw, 2400px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Beloved outdoor attractions</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Visit the iconic carved poles and Mungo Martin House (Wawadiťła) in Thunderbird Park, explore our native plant garden, and see St. Ann’s Schoolhouse: the oldest standing building in Victoria.</p>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid one-third-two-thirds is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-6 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2400" height="1601" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0410227.webp" alt="Wide shot of two women taking a smiling selfie inside the musem. The woman taking the picture in front has brown hair and glasses. She holding a glass of beer and is wearing a floral dress and orange cardigan. The woman behind has black hair and is holding a glass of white wine and wearing a black shirt. Behind them is a brick wall. They are bathed in pink and blue light, and around them are other museum guests milling about." class="wp-image-1700" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0410227.webp 2400w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0410227-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0410227-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0410227-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0410227-1536x1025.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0410227-2048x1366.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2400px) 100vw, 2400px" /></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-12 is-layout-constrained wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Authentic local experiences</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our bustling events calendar, independent food trucks, and shop full of distinctly BC gifts and art make us a favourite among Victoria residents. We’re proud to be a trusted destination for learning and connection in our beautiful city.</p>
</div>
</div>

                                  <div class="tab-content" id="panel-3-foryou"
                      hidden role="tabpanel" tabindex="-1"
                      aria-labelledby="tab-3-foryou">
                    <h2>For Local Residents &amp; Businesses</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Reunite with old favourites and dive headfirst into fresh cultural perspectives.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">If you haven’t paid&nbsp;us a visit in the past few years, you might be surprised at what&#8217;s happening here.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our near-daily events and seasonal world-class exhibitions mean there’s always something fresh to see during your next visit. We have events tailored for both families and adults, online and in-person. Whether you’re a newcomer to Victoria or a lifelong resident, you’ll make new memories that connect you to living histories.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The stories of BC run deep, and the museum is here to bring them to the surface. We want you to see yourself and your community reflected in this work. That’s why we’re always enhancing our offerings to make them as diverse as the people who live here.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Let us (re)-introduce ourselves, and we’ll see you soon.&nbsp;</p>

                                  <div class="tab-content" id="panel-4-foryou"
                      hidden role="tabpanel" tabindex="-1"
                      aria-labelledby="tab-4-foryou">
                    <h2>For Indigenous Communities</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">There are many opportunities for Indigenous peoples and their communities to engage with the Royal BC Museum.</p>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Across the museum, we are committed to reconciliation, and supporting Indigenous communities in reclaiming, researching and caring for cultural belongings on their own terms.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our <a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/indigenous-collections-and-repatriation/" data-type="page" data-id="1988">Indigenous Collections and Repatriation (ICAR) department</a> works with First Nations, Métis and Inuit communities across BC to care for and return cultural belongings. The department also supports community access to the museum’s collections and helps ensure that Indigenous perspectives shape how these materials are preserved and shared.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-1024x683.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-3514" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2022MG0824-036-web-2048x1365.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">Former Repatriation Specialist Michelle Washington in the collections. Print: Art Thompson,&nbsp;<em>Sea Urchin</em>, ICAR 14890 A,B</figcaption></figure>
</div>
</div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Visit the museum</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Indigenous peoples receive free admission</strong>: Simply inform staff at the admission desk when you arrive. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our team is in the process of revisiting the ways Indigenous materials are presented at the museum. These exhibitions have been recently updated in collaboration with community: </p>



<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Our Living Languages</h4>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Developed in partnership with the First Peoples’ Cultural Council, this exhibition shares the history of disrupted languages in BC, the complexity of these languages, and the people working tirelessly to document and revitalize them.</p>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Jonathan Hunt House</h4>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This ceremonial house and museum installation allows visitors to enter a recreation of the house of Chief Kwakwabalasami, the late Jonathan Hunt, a Kwakwaka’wakw chief who was born and lived his life in the community of Tsaxis, near Fort Rupert, BC.</p>

                                  <div class="tab-content" id="panel-5-foryou"
                      hidden role="tabpanel" tabindex="-1"
                      aria-labelledby="tab-5-foryou">
                    <h2>For Students</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Learning adventures for everything BC</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">We have many resources for all grade levels about BC&#8217;s natural and cultural history that you can use and enjoy. Learn with us in-person or online, and discover the many stories that make up this amazing province.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="682" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-1024x682.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-3948" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-1024x682.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2024MG0217064_web.webp 2000w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Some of the things you can do here:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Explore animal habitats:</strong> Encounter caribou and grizzlies in our forests, and learn about ancient dinosaurs and mammoths who lived here</li>



<li><strong>Learn about living Indigenous cultures</strong>: Listen to unique languages and explore a ceremonial Kwakwaka’wakw house</li>



<li><strong>Step back in time</strong>: See what life in BC was like over 100 years ago with old-fashioned homes, shops and a photography studio </li>



<li><strong>See world-class exhibits</strong>: We have new special interactive galleries every season</li>



<li><strong>Go to the movies</strong>: Watch epic IMAX<sup class="trademark">®</sup> documentaries on BC&#8217;s biggest screen&nbsp;</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">It doesn’t matter if you’re here for school work or your own interests. As long as you’re just a little bit curious, we’ll have something that will surprise you.&nbsp;When you use the museum in your studies, you can trust what you find here. Everything we say and do is informed by experts in their field who make sure what we share is factual and includes many perspectives.</p>

                    <h2>For Educators</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">A world of enriching experiences&nbsp;</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The Royal BC Museum gives schools and educators the resources to bring K-12 classrooms to life. Our museum educators open doors to BC’s natural and cultural legacy, inspiring curiosity and delight while embracing Indigenous learning principles.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">No matter where in BC you teach, we offer a variety of onsite and online offerings and resources designed to captivate and inform students about the place we call home.&nbsp;</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://rbcm.ca/learning-department/">More about the Learning Department</a></div>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2024MG1116240-1024x683.webp" alt="Students participating in a class activity at the museum. Many children are gathered around a white table with a small model of Stonehenge, holding papers and pencils. Three have their hands raised. On the right is a woman with grey hair and glasses, wearing a red lanyard and speaking to them. Behind, a woman wearing glasses and a red hijab looks on thoughtfully." class="wp-image-958" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2024MG1116240-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2024MG1116240-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2024MG1116240-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2024MG1116240-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2024MG1116240-2048x1365.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>

<div style="height:2.25rem" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer spacer-small"></div>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why learn with RBCM?</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">From dinosaurs to the living languages of Indigenous peoples to changing ecosystems, our on-site and online offerings explore a wide range of topics about BC, and subjects beyond our borders with a BC lens. Our exhibitions, resources and events are informed by experts, many working right here at the museum and in partnership with institutions around the world.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Serving educators and creating meaningful learning experiences is core to our mandate. Visiting the museum is a hallmark memory for generations of BC students and teachers, and our offerings continue to evolve so that they’re just as memorable for today’s learners.</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0426452-1024x683.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-1706" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0426452-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0426452-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0426452-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0426452-1536x1025.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/VERT_2025MG0426452-2048x1366.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Offerings for K-12 teachers</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our wide range of programs are designed by museum educators to enrich your curriculum and foster active engagement and critical thinking. Through our inquiry-based, age-appropriate learning programs, we bring the museum and learning to life.</p>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Adult education</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Experience the museum and archives like never before with offerings tailored for adult learners. You’ll learn from experts, re-connect with the museum and explore from a new perspective. Culture, history and community are at the heart of our educational mission.</p>

                    <h2>For Natural History Nerds</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:66%">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The magnificent plants and animals of British Columbia come to life at the museum.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Plus, did you know our Natural History collection has over 370,000 fascinating specimens? Together, they tell the story of life from millions of years ago to today’s vital ecosystems.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Whether you’re a researcher looking to connect with experts, or simply curious about local flora and fauna, we have endless wonders for you to discover.</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/">More about the Natural History department</a></div>
</div>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">See BC&#8217;s natural history at the museum</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">In our interactive displays, step into in BC&#8217;s diverse landscapes. Encounter modern-day coastal forests, Ice Age landscapes where mammoths rule, and underwater sea cliffs.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Keen minds can engage with our exhibitions and learning programs that bring you up close to life-size replicas, real specimens, and live exhibits all backed by expert knowledge.</p>

<div style="height:4.5rem" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer spacer-medium"></div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Discover our collection</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our vast Natural History collection of specimens and artifacts is organized into several key areas:&nbsp;</p>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/botany-2/" data-type="page" data-id="493">Botany</a></strong>, including vascular plants, mosses, and lichens. It’s one of the biggest reference collections of BC plants in the world.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/entomology/">Entomology</a></strong>, showcasing the diversity of insects and other terrestrial arthropods.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/herpetology/">Herpetology</a></strong>, where we document the diversity of amphibians and reptiles.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/ichthyology/">Ichthyology</a></strong>, where we dive into BC’s waters to understand tens of thousands of fish species.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/invertebrate-zoology/">Invertebrates</a></strong>, including corals, jellyfish, and mollusks.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/mammalogy/">Mammalogy</a></strong>, with hundreds of amazing species of all sizes represented.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/ornithology/">Ornithology</a></strong>, where we take flight with thousands of bird species from across the province.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/natural-history/palaeontology/">Palaeontology</a></strong>, with over 60,000 fossils spanning 500 million years and capturing ancient life like nowhere else. And&nbsp;yes, that includes dinosaurs!</p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="461" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-1024x461.webp" alt="A museum worker examining a wood log specimen on a shelf. She is wearing glasses, a white lab coat and disposable gloves. She holds up a plastic tape against the wood, which is partially covered in bubble wrap. Inside the wide, short shelf is a bright lamp, a large dark tube, other specimens and a box with papers inside." class="wp-image-1551" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-1024x461.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-300x135.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-768x346.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-1536x691.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1118035-1-e1747938302119-2048x922.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-1024x683.webp" alt="A museum worker examines a specimen in the jar. He is wearing glasses and a white face mask, stands in a laboratory." class="wp-image-1658" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-1024x683.webp 1024w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-300x200.webp 300w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-768x512.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-1536x1024.webp 1536w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2022MG1020002-web-1-2048x1366.webp 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The collection is a vital resource for scientists across Canada and around the world, as we document and study BC’s stunning biodiversity.&nbsp;</p>

                                  <div class="tab-content" id="panel-8-foryou"
                      hidden role="tabpanel" tabindex="-1"
                      aria-labelledby="tab-8-foryou">
                    <h2>For Human History Lovers</h2>
                    <div class="responsive-type">
                      
<div class="wp-block-columns grid two-columns-equal is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">We tell stories of culture, community and society in British Columbia from ancient history to present day.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Ranging across centuries and every corner of the province, the Human Histories department works to reveal the diversity of life in BC.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Although we have many countless artifacts from years past, the work doesn’t stop there. You’ll also find engaging exhibitions and events with unique perspectives on modern life and community.</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/">More about the Human Histories department</a></div>
</div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column col-span-9 is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1258" height="1675" src="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1.webp" alt="" class="wp-image-3382" srcset="https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1.webp 1258w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-225x300.webp 225w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-769x1024.webp 769w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-768x1023.webp 768w, https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2025MG0125100-edited-1-1154x1536.webp 1154w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1258px) 100vw, 1258px" /></figure>
</div>
</div>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">On view at the museum</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Step inside immersive galleries that transport you to different eras. The recently updated <em>Old Town, New Approach </em>and the sailing ship <em>HMS Discovery</em> bring you up close with life in BC in from the 18th to early 20<sup>th</sup> century.&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Explore Indigenous peoples&#8217; enduring cultures and traditions. Hear the words of the 30+ First Nations languages in <em>Our Living Languages</em>. Step inside the evocative, recreated ceremonial house and exhibit of Chief Kwakwabalasami (Jonathan Hunt).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Plus, develop a deeper understanding and more memorable experience by joining tours and events led by knowledgeable educators. These fun and informative sessions add details and texture to make every visit unforgettable.</p>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Discover our collection</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Our extensive Human Histories collection is structured into several areas:</p>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column wp-block-column--accent-line is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/bc-archaeology/" data-type="page" data-id="4854">BC Archaeology collection</a></strong> has over 215,000 items that capture 10,000 years of history. Together these objects, cultural belongings, specimens and artifacts paint a unique picture of how people have lived on this land, particularly Indigenous communities.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The RBCM is also the BC Provincial Archaeology Repository. See our <a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/bc-archaeology/#repository-resources">repository resources for Archaeologists</a>.  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/indigenous-collections-and-repatriation/" data-type="page" data-id="1988">Indigenous collection</a></strong> has over 14,000 cultural belongings from the 19th century to now, from monumental poles to beaded jewelry. This collection is frequently activated through our <a href="https://rbcm.ca/indigenous-collections-and-repatriation/" data-type="page" data-id="1988">Indigenous Collections and Repatriation (ICAR) department</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/indigenous-audio-visual/" data-type="page" data-id="5022">Indigenous Audiovisual collection</a></strong> has over 65,000 images, films and sound recordings that capture Indigenous ways of life in BC.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The <strong><a href="https://rbcm.ca/human-history/modern-history/" data-type="page" data-id="4314">History collection</a></strong> has over 165,000 objects significant to BC and its more recent stories. They document ethnic history, government, evolving industries, community groups and daily life. Textiles are a particular focus with over 32,000 items.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Taken as a whole, these items speak to the diversity, myriad ways of life, and evolving societies of this province. </p>
</div>

              <section class="grid">
                <div class="col-span-10">
                  <h3>Exploring the stories of British Columbia together</h3>
                  <p><p>The Royal BC Museum is dedicated to preserving, researching and educating everyone about the natural and human stories that make up British Columbia. A place of reflection, learning and discussion, the museum continually updates its collection and programming to encourage curiosity about the past, present, and future of the province. </p>
<p>The main facilities are located in Victoria on the territory of the lək̓ʷəŋən (Lekwungen) peoples (Songhees and Xwsepsum Nations). In addition to our collection of over 7 million objects, the museum includes the BC Archives, the IMAX<sup class="trademark">®</sup> Victoria theatre, the surrounding Cultural Precinct and the Royal BC Museum Shop.  </p>
</p>

      <div class="post-header content grid">
        <div class="col-span-14 post-header-content">
          <h1 class="h2 bold">BC Archives To Temporarily Close November 22 As Collections Move To New Campus</h1>

          
          <div class="post-header-meta">
            <time>November 19, 2026</time>
                          <span class="bold"> · Press Release</span>
                      </div>
        </div>

        <div class="col-span-4">
                      <div class="post-header-author">
              
              <p class="bold text-medium"></p>
              <p class=""></p>
            </div>
                  </div>
      </div>
    </div>

          <div class="content content--text-medium">
        
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">VICTORIA, BC —The BC Archives will close to the public on November 22, 2026, as its collections, staff and services move from downtown Victoria to the new Provincial Archives, Research and Collections (PARC) Campus in Colwood.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This move is part of a long-term effort to strengthen the preservation and care of British Columbia’s archival collections. Developed by the Royal BC Museum in partnership with the Province of British Columbia, PARC Campus will provide a dedicated home for the BC Archives and the provincial collections it preserves.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">&#8220;Moving to PARC Campus marks an exciting new chapter for the BC Archives. PARC Campus will provide a home for irreplaceable records that support research and community knowledge, and safeguard our broader understanding of British Columbia&#8217;s past and present,” says Dr. Jodi Giesbrecht, Vice President of Archives, Research and Collections at the Royal BC Museum. “We recognize the impact of the temporary closure and look forward to welcoming people into this exceptional new home.&#8221;&nbsp;</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">As preparations for the move continue, access to records held at the downtown location is gradually decreasing. These materials will remain unavailable while they are being moved and unpacked at PARC Campus. The downtown location will close for several months while staff prepare the new reading room, which is expected to open by appointment in spring 2027. Regular services are anticipated to resume in fall 2027.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Although access to on-site collections will be interrupted, researchers will still be able to consult open digitized records through the BC Archives collection databases. Limited access may also be provided for time-sensitive legal purposes.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Online resources also offer opportunities to explore the Archives’ holdings during the closure. The new <a href="https://bcarchives.ca/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/SSA_Research-Guide_06_26.pdf" data-type="link" data-id="https://bcarchives.ca/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/SSA_Research-Guide_06_26.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sisters of Saint Ann Research Guide</a> helps researchers discover records documenting the history of the Congregation of the Sisters of Saint Anne in British Columbia, including material relevant to residential and day school history, Indigenous communities and access to records.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The guide is part of ongoing work to improve access to records connected to residential schools and has been made possible through a digitization project with the University of British Columbia’s Indian Residential School History and Dialogue Centre.&nbsp; These records can support research by First Nations, residential school survivors and their families, as well as language revitalization initiatives.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Royal BC Museum Foundation has supported this work through funding for the Sisters of St. Ann archival project.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">“The Foundation was pleased to steward the funds from the Sisters of St. Ann for this project and to support this archival work,” says Heather Jones, Director of Development, Royal BC Museum Foundation.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The transition to PARC Campus will establish a new home for the BC Archives, supporting the preservation of provincial records and their continued use by researchers and communities.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For details about the move and temporary closure, visit the <a href="https://bcarchives.ca/parc-faq/" data-type="link" data-id="https://bcarchives.ca/parc-faq/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">BC Archives PARC Campus FAQ</a>. For information about available services during the transition, visit the <a href="https://bcarchives.ca/service-changes/" data-type="link" data-id="https://bcarchives.ca/service-changes/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">BC Archives service changes page</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Questions about the move and transition can be sent to <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#8bdbcad9c8fafeeef8ffe2e4e5f8cbf9e4f2eae7e9e8e6fef8eefee6a5e9e8a5e8ea"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="752534273604001006011c1a1b0635071a0c141917161800061000185b17165b1614">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>. For all other BC Archives requests, contact <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#670604040214142715081e060b05040a121402120a490504490406"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="a6c7c5c5c3d5d5e6d4c9dfc7cac4c5cbd3d5c3d3cb88c4c588c5c7">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>.</p>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">— 30 —</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>About the Royal BC Museum:</strong> The Royal BC Museum, which includes BC Archives, IMAX<sup class="trademark">®</sup> Victoria and PARC Campus, is one of the oldest continually operating museums in Canada. A centre of learning and research, it strives to broaden our understanding of British Columbia through collections, exhibitions, outreach and community engagement. The museum celebrates the province’s diverse landscapes and the lives of the people who live here, enables research and knowledge sharing that advances our understanding of our world, and provides a dynamic place for discussion and reflection. IMAX<sup class="trademark">®</sup> Victoria delivers educational and entertaining experiences that accompany the learning journey the museum offers.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We acknowledge the lək̓ʷəŋən (Place to Smoke Herring People) also known as the Songhees and Xwsepsum (Esquimalt) Nations as the traditional keepers of these lands and waters. It is with gratitude we learn to live, work and walk respectfully on their lands today.</p>
